correctness.rationale: Tame Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus 4. Valuations at all six branch points and infinity produce a basis U,H,W,J. The exact semilinear Cartier map is U→J+sqrt(a)W+sqrt(b)H=:V, W→U, H,J→0 and V→a^(1/4)U. Therefore all iterates have ranks 2 if a!=0 and 2,1,0,... if a=0. Distinct squarefree witness quintics show both loci occur; a transforms to a/u² under affine base changes. A pure-Python GF4 exhaustive check over 768 smooth quintics plus 9216 coordinate checks and independent F2 zeta counts corroborate the proof, not replace it.

value.rationale: The exact branch-symmetric coefficient equation provides an effective Hasse divisor description for a natural entire genus-four trielliptic family, refining the already-known abstract dimension-two p-rank-zero Shimura stratum. It separates 2-ranks 0 and 2 with constant a-number 2 and determines every Cartier power, so it is a complete geometric classification of this natural invariant, not an arbitrary finite slice or a merely negative observation. The method is elementary and the claimed scale of novelty correspondingly limited.
